jobs.title: Relationship Manager -  Business Resiliency Office -Executive Director
jobs.description:
The Firmwide Resiliency Office (FRO), which is part of the Office of the Chief Financial Officer, is seeking a talented Resiliency Executive Director to join our team to lead engagement with lines of business and corporate functions to drive forward the Firmwide Resiliency strategic priorities. This is a great opportunity to use your stakeholder relationship skills and work with senior leaders throughout the firm.

As a Business Resiliency Relationship Manager in the Firmwide Resiliency Office, you will partner closely with FRO team members and engage the broader resiliency ecosystem. Additionally, you will align stakeholders, remove obstacles, surface insights via executive-ready narratives and analytics and deliver change at scale through disciplined change management and continuous improvement.

Job Responsibilities:

• Own the Firmwide Resiliency relationship with the Line of Business (LOB) through day-to-day partnership with the business, leading engagement, integration, and change management for resiliency

• Drive risk articulation model and escalation protocol to the businesses, ensuring escalation to the right forums such as business control committees, steering committees, etc.

• Manage change management for firmwide resiliency initiatives, ensuring LOB adoption and successful embedment of new capabilities, standards, and tooling.

• Deepen partnership between the businesses and the Firmwide Resiliency Office; be the escalation and decision-making forum for LOB-specific resiliency issues.

• Serve as the two-way translator: business context in, resiliency requirements out.

• Work with the businesses to strengthen resiliency ownership to ensure regular senior-level review of essential services, third-party dependencies, resiliency assumptions, and kill-switch readiness.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills:

• 10 years of senior leadership experience owning firmwide resiliency initiatives and/or advising executives on strategy and risk.

• Proven ability to run a coverage/relationship model (e.g., LOB champions), serve as a trusted escalation point, and influence outcomes without direct authority.

• Strong change management expertise including driving adoption and embedment of new resiliency capabilities, standards, processes, and tooling across diverse stakeholders.

• Strong understanding of operational resiliency concepts and ability to challenge practical viability of plans.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a track record of producing executive-ready materials, briefing senior stakeholders, and clearly framing issues, decisions, and escalation paths.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail; ability to synthesize complex information into clear insights and action

jobs.title: Product Director – Business Resiliency- Executive Director
jobs.description:
Shape the future of the firmwide resiliency product as we rethink and rebuild a platform that can stand up to the rapidly evolving technology and threat landscape we face.

As a Product Director in Firmwide Resiliency Product Management, you will own the product strategy and delivery of the future state Resiliency product used by Business Resiliency and Technology Resiliency managers to plan for and respond to business disruptions as they are occurring in real time. You will be accountable for the delivery of an end to end integrated system by partnering with stakeholders from the Businesses and Functions and other firmwide teams such as Corporate Third Party Oversight, Cyber and Tech Controls. You will set an outcome driven roadmap, leverage AI and operate with a “speed-to-production” mindset, using iterative delivery approaches (e.g., Pizza POD model) to rapidly prototype, validate with users, and scale durable capabilities.

Job responsibilities

• Define and drive product strategy for a Resiliency Product pillar and manage a team of product owners through execution.
• Lead customer discovery (research, workflow analysis, pain-point identification) to translate user needs into a prioritized roadmap and clear value proposition.
• Lead AI enablement within the product, identifying high-impact use cases (e.g., NLP-driven insights, automation, decision support), shaping an AI integration strategy, and guiding responsible deployment with appropriate controls and monitoring.
• Deliver iteratively using agile practices and small, empowered teams (e.g., Pizza POD), accelerating time-to-value through rapid prototyping, and continuous feedback loops.
• Coaches and mentors the Resiliency Product team on best practices, such as solution generation, market research, prototyping methods, product adoption strategies, and product delivery, enabling them to effectively deliver on objectives.
• Partners across line of defense to identify, validate, and scale reusable testing solutions and components, driving efficiency and scale.
• Own and maintain the product backlog, ensuring epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria are well-defined, testable, and aligned to outcomes (and evolving approach as the firm evolves the software development lifecycle).
• Establish and track success metrics (e.g., tester productivity, cycle time, coverage, control outcomes, reliability, risk posture, and cost) and use data to guide prioritization and investment decisions.
• Act as the voice of the customer, partnering with stakeholders to evolve operational policies, process flows, procedures, tooling, and user communications where required to enable adoption.
• Evaluate “build vs. partner vs. defer” decisions for emerging AI/ agentic capabilities and balancing speed, scalability, and risk.
• Support go-to-market and change management including launch planning, training/ readiness, documentation, and post-launch support to drive adoption and measurable business impact.
Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

• Demonstrated experience owning and delivering a product(s) across the full product lifecycle (discovery, delivery, adoption, optimization), with accountability for outcomes and performance.
• Hands-on experience delivering AI-enabled capabilities in production (e.g., NLP, intelligent automation, decision support), including model/ product iteration, monitoring, and stakeholder readiness.
• Experience incorporating agentic patterns/ workflows into products (e.g., orchestration, tool-use, human-in-the-loop review) with an emphasis on control, transparency, and auditability.
• Proven ability to deliver in an iterative, fast-paced model using short development cycles and small teams (e.g., Pizza POD), partnering tightly with design and engineering.
• Strong stakeholder management across Engineering, UI/UX Design, Data, Resiliency, Compliance, and senior leadership-aligning outcomes, negotiating trade-offs, and driving timely decisions.
• Proven track record leading large, complex initiatives impacting multiple stakeholders, with strong written/oral communication at a senior executive level.
• Understanding of risk and controls concepts, in risk management, assessment, control evaluations, testing, or a related field.
• 10 years of experience delivering products, projects, or technology applications at scale.
• Strong knowledge of the product development lifecycle, technical design concepts, and data/ analytics fundamentals; ability to translate complex needs into clear requirements.
• Experience driving organizational change and enabling adoption through communications, training, and operating model/process updates.

Preferred qualifications

, capabilities, and skills

• Experience working in or closely with audit, compliance, risk management; strong understanding of internal controls.
• Experience with modern data and analytics tools (e.g., Databricks, ThoughtSpot, Genie, Sigma, Prophecy, Python).

jobs.title: Vice President, Business Resiliency Manager, HR
jobs.description:
Global Human Resources (HR) Business Resiliency’s mission is to continuously improve our businesses’ ability to provide outstanding products and services to customers during disruptions.

As a Business Resiliency Manager on the HR Business Resiliency team, you will report to the Global HR Business Resiliency Incident Management Lead and help lead HR incident management for the Americas. You will proactively engage HR stakeholders and firmwide partners to build strong working relationships, understand emerging risks, and support readiness before incidents occur. During an incident, you will coordinate response activities across HR and firmwide partners, support employee needs when required, assess evolving situations, and confidently guide stakeholders toward clear, timely decisions and actions.

In addition, you will provide guidance and governance as business stakeholders develop their Business Resiliency Plans and related artifacts in accordance with JPMorganChase Firmwide Business Resiliency (FBR) Standards. You will partner with process owners to ensure effective, compliant plans are documented and tested so HR operations can continue with minimal impact during disruptive events.

This role requires a visible, proactive leader who can influence across teams, communicate with confidence, and foster accountability while maintaining constructive relationships. You will work across the organization to identify, communicate, and mitigate resiliency-related risks, while fostering an inclusive team environment that inspires trust and development.

Job Responsibilities

• Maintain an alert posture for local, regional, and global crisis incidents identified and communicated by the Global Security Operations Center.

• Lead and coordinate HR end to end Incident Management process from monitor/invoke to completion of post incident reporting for HR Business Resiliency Plan activations, and support wider firm events that require employee-support functions.

• Proactively engage HR stakeholders and firmwide partners to understand business needs, identify emerging risks, clarify roles and expectations, and strengthen incident readiness.

• Provide concise, executive-level incident updates and lead post-incident reviews to capture lessons learned and strengthen incident-management practices.

• Build and maintain Business Resiliency expertise to support consistent program execution, provide confident direction to stakeholders, and develop knowledge of the supported HR functions.

• Lead and coordinate business participation in resiliency testing, as required by HR objectives and FBR Standards, including tabletop exercises and physical testing.

• Test and improve incident-management processes, practices, and tools with global partners to strengthen incident-management capabilities.

• Promote the resiliency program by communicating policy or system changes clearly and concisely and offering additional support as needed.

• Lead department-centric projects that build on your strengths or interests, develop new skills, and advance team objectives.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.

• 7+ years of relevant experience in business resiliency and/or incident management.

• Detail-oriented, with strong project-management and organizational skills.

• Clear, concise verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate with people at all levels of the organization.

• Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.

• Demonstrated track record of meeting deadlines, delivering results, and taking accountability for an independent workload.

• Strong relationship-building and networking skills across firm functions and geographies, with the ability to expand influence, knowledge, and collaboration with senior leaders.

• Ability to promote continuous process improvement with a risk-and-controls mindset.

• Ability to handle pressure and lead or assist with crisis management when needed.

• Availability to support the business during disruptive events, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.

Preferred qualifications

, capabilities and skills

• Business continuity and/or crisis management experience (accreditations are favorable e.g., Certiﬁed Business Continuity Professional (CBCP))

jobs.title: AI Technology and Operational Risk, Vice President, Dallas
jobs.description:
The Operational Risk Department at Goldman Sachs is an independent risk management function responsible for developing and implementing a standardized framework to identify, measure, and monitor operational risk across the firm. The AI Lead for AI Resilience is a specialized role within this framework, dedicated to strengthening the firm's oversight of AI-related risks arising from the operational resilience of AI systems, including their availability, recoverability, continuity, and ability to withstand and adapt to disruption.

This professional will be responsible for continuously identifying, monitoring, measuring, and assessing operational risks associated with the resilience of the firm's AI systems, ensuring that AI platforms, foundational models, agentic systems, and their supporting infrastructure are architected and operated to prevent, respond to, recover from, and adapt to operational disruptions in a manner consistent with the firm's operational resilience and artificial intelligence frameworks, policies, and standards.

The role ensures that AI systems supporting the firm's business operations — and in particular those that are dependent assets of Important Business Services (IBSs) — remain within impact tolerances during severe but plausible disruptions, and that AI-specific resilience risks are embedded into the firm's Business Continuity Planning (BCP), testing, monitoring, and crisis response programs.

Responsibilities

• Identify, monitor, and analyze operational risks arising from the resilience of AI systems , with a focus on risks such as AI infrastructure unavailability, foundational model outages, non-deterministic behavior under stress, cascading failures in multi-agent systems, model degradation from data drift, agent state persistence loss, and the unavailability of third-party hosted LLMs and MCP server ecosystems. Develop evidence-based challenges focused on improving the resilience posture of AI systems.

• Ensure AI systems that qualify as dependent assets (technology deployments, data assets, and vendors) are appropriately identified, mapped, and documented within Business Continuity Plans in the firmwide resilience tooling.

• Identify AI systems that are Integral Assets to Important Business Services and ensure they are subject to heightened resilience assessment, documented Impact Tolerance Statements , and alternate workaround strategies (e.g., model fallback, alternate vendors, manual processes) in the event of unavailability.

• Champion resilience-by-design principles — modularity, diversity, redundancy, and adaptability — across the AI technology stack, ensuring resilience controls are embedded into AI system architecture from inception rather than retrofitted.

• Monitor the firm's AI resilience control inventory for sufficiency and completeness, challenging the absence or inadequate implementation of controls such as, AI Model Version Pinning, AI System Observability, multi-data-center deployment, System Acceptance Testing, circuit-breaker/fallback procedures, and human feedback loops.

• Conduct evidence-based scenario analysis by working with stakeholders to develop severe but plausible tail-risk scenarios around AI resilience failures, including foundational model provider outages, cascading multi-agent degradation, data-drift-driven model decay, and third-party AI vendor unavailability. Ensure these scenarios are reflected in the firm's scenario library and integrated testing.

• Support integrated testing, asset-based testing, and response testing of AI-dependent IBSs to demonstrate the firm's ability to remain within impact tolerances during disruption, coordinating with 1LoD Engineering, TPRM, and business stakeholders.

• Conduct data analysis to identify trends and patterns in AI system availability, observability telemetry, recovery performance, and the IBS Resilience Score , augmenting quantitative analysis with qualitative observations through bespoke metrics at firmwide and divisional/sub-divisional levels. Escalate concerns to senior management when warranted.

• Facilitate operational risk event and data collection related to AI resilience incidents and business disruption events , ensuring reporting through the Operational Risk Event Reporting process.

• Contribute to divisional and functional risk profile assessments by highlighting AI resilience risk issues and trends to senior divisional managers and the senior Operational Risk management team.

• Oversee resilience aspects of model governance within the tech stack , ensuring AI models and agentic systems are subject to version pinning, observability, ongoing monitoring for degradation/drift/decay, and documented circuit-breaker plans to offline or pause use cases below established accuracy or availability thresholds.

• Ensure alignment of AI resilience posture with the firm's risk appetite , reviewing architectural and deployment decisions for consistency with recovery time objectives (RTO), recovery point objectives (RPO), service level agreements (SLA), and impact tolerances.

• Review New Activities and ensure operational resilience risks arising from new AI model deployments, agentic system rollouts, new AI vendor engagements, and infrastructure migrations are properly considered before go-live.

• Contribute to review and challenge of AI resilience control assessments to ensure the Risk and Control Self-Assessment (RCSA) outcomes are consistent, credible, and underpinned by appropriate evidence.

• Support the firm's AI risk governance bodies by providing resilience-focused metrics, thresholds, and escalation protocols for AI usage.

• Remain current on business drivers, regulatory and industry changes impacting AI resilience obligations across relevant jurisdictions.

• Identify and drive initiatives that improve AI resilience risk management activities at the firm.

Qualifications

• Strong understanding of operational resilience concepts , including Business Continuity Planning, Business Impact Analysis, impact tolerances, integrated testing, RTO/RPO, and disaster recovery.
• Strong understanding of AI/ML architecture concepts , including foundation models, LLMs, RAG systems, agentic AI frameworks, MCP servers, vector databases, and model deployment infrastructure.
• Experience with resilience-by-design principles (modularity, diversity, redundancy, adaptability), AI infrastructure resilience, Quality of Service/DDoS prevention, and observability frameworks.
• Knowledge of internal control and resilience frameworks and relevant regulatory obligations for AI and operational resilience.
• Strong business acumen with general awareness of technology-related processes, risks, and business flows in financial services.
• 7+ years of relevant experience, which could include working in operational risk, operational resilience/business continuity, a financial institution's technology division, a technology company that builds or maintains enterprise AI/ML systems, cloud services, or IT/Information Security auditing.
• Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to present with impact and influence.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with a strong delivery focus.
• Strong organizational skills; project management experience a plus.
• Proficiency in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint/OneDrive; SQL, graph databases, and Tableau would be a plus.
• Relevant certifications such as CISA, CISM, CBCP/MBCI (business continuity), or related AI/ML and resilience certifications.
• Familiarity with enterprise risk management best practices and controls.
• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Business and Technology Management, Finance, Data Science, or related disciplines.

jobs.title: Tech Risk and Controls Lead — Tech Resiliency Testing
jobs.description:
Join our team to play a pivotal role in mitigating tech risks and upholding operational excellence, driving innovation in risk management.

As a Tech Risk & Controls Lead within the Infrastructure Platforms (IP) team, you will be responsible for identifying, and mitigating compliance and operational risks in line with the firm's standards. You will also provide subject matter expertise and technical guidance to technology-aligned process owners, ensuring that implemented controls are operating effectively and in compliance with regulatory, legal, and industry standards. By partnering with various stakeholders, including Product Owners, Business Control Managers, and Regulators, you will contribute to the reporting of a comprehensive view of technology risk posture and its impact on the business. Your advanced knowledge of risk management principles, practices, and theories will enable you to drive innovative solutions and effectively manage a diverse team in a dynamic and evolving risk landscape.

Within IP, you will lead Technology Resiliency testing across the firm's datacenter and cloud estate worldwide. You will own the planning, execution and closure of resiliency events. You will represent IP for Technology Resiliency, partnering closely with lines of business and Cybersecurity and Technology Controls, and help keep improving our Resiliency Operating Framework in line with firmwide and regulatory obligations. AI is central to how this role operates. We are looking for a leader who defaults to AI-assisted ways of working: automating manual effort, speeding up documentation, mining test and incident data for insight, and raising the quality and speed of every process the team owns. This role requires flexibility to work weekends, on average once a month, as many resiliency events are scheduled outside business hours.

Job responsibilities

• Own the end-to-end lifecycle of datacenter and cloud resiliency test events, from scoping against current compliance status and building the execution schedule to preparing run-books and managing deliverables such as change records and the testing timetable
• Uses enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to accelerate synthesis of risk/control evidence and draft executive-ready reporting, validating outputs and handling data according to sensitivity and security requirements
• Lead live test execution on behalf of IP, running the command center, securing participation from all stakeholders and keeping business partners and senior management informed throughout
• Identify, quantify and communicate resiliency risk through post-test and post-incident analysis, evaluating successful and failed recoveries, performing root cause analysis, and driving re-tests or corrective actions through to closure
• Champion practical AI adoption across the team, using LLM tools such as Claude and AI-assisted development environments such as VS Code to automate manual effort, accelerate run-book and documentation production, and reduce touchpoints during failover and recovery events
• Promotes reuse-first, AI-assisted approaches to streamline recurring control testing and issue/action-plan management routines, ensuring human review and alignment to auditability and regulatory expectations
• Apply AI to analyze test results, incident history and compliance data at scale, surfacing recurring failure modes and remediation priorities, and embed reusable prompts and patterns into the team's operating model while coaching colleagues on effective, responsible use
• Drive the resiliency roadmap across public and private cloud and cyber resiliency controls, using AWS services to design, test and evidence multi-region, multi-availability-zone and hybrid datacenter-to-cloud recovery
• Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of resiliency controls against Firmwide Business Resilience standards, including Technology Recovery Action Plans (TRAP) for cyber and data-loss scenarios, identifying gaps and recommending enhancements
• Execute reporting and governance of test compliance, controls and issue management, giving senior management regular insight into risks, exceptions, requests not to test and escalations
• Develop and maintain trusted relationships with application and product owners, LOB technologists, Cybersecurity and Technology Controls, and Firmwide Business Resilience partners to drive alignment on resiliency outcomes

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

• 5+ years of experience or equivalent expertise in technology risk management, cybersecurity, or a related field, with a focus on regulatory compliance and risk mitigation
• Demonstrated experience using enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to support technology risk and controls workflows with strong validation habits and awareness of data sensitivity.
• Ability to review and validate AI-assisted risk summaries and recommendations before use, escalating when uncertain and ensuring outcomes align to security, auditability, and regulatory expectations.
• Strong background in overall technology experience, with hands-on platform, infrastructure or production support roles
• Demonstrated experience planning and coordinating datacenter or cloud resilience, disaster recovery or technology power-down events, with working fluency in failover and failback strategies and concepts such as RTO, RPO, HA and DR
• Hands-on experience with AWS products and services, including those used for resilience, backup, replication and multi-region recovery
• Practical, hands-on proficiency with LLM tools such as Claude and AI-assisted development environments such as VS Code, applied to automating and improving day-to-day work
• Proficient knowledge of risk management and technology resiliency frameworks, control evaluation, design and governance, and risk assessment and reporting
• Program or project management discipline across scope, schedule, critical path and deliverables, with proven success leading a team or function to metrics and quality targets, backed by strong analytical and problem-solving skills
• Demonstrated ability to influence executive-level decision-making and negotiate competing priorities, with confident executive presence and excellent verbal, written and presentation skills
• BS/BA degree in a related technical or business discipline, or equivalent practical experience

Preferred qualifications

, capabilities, and skills

• Financial services industry experience, with knowledge of financial industry regulatory requirements for technology resiliency and familiarity with Control Objectives and Procedures
• Experience in large, global, multi-cultural organizations supporting mission-critical, highly available applications, including third-party vendor management
• Track record of delivering measurable efficiency gains through AI and automation, including prompt engineering, AI agents or workflow orchestration, and the ability to evangelize and scale those practices across a team
• Modern engineering skills such as scripting or programming, data analytics and cloud engineering (for example Infrastructure-as-Code, CI/CD, observability tooling), with a demonstrated desire for continued self-improvement
• Business continuity accreditation (for example CBCP) and/or AWS certification (for example Cloud Practitioner or Sys Ops Administrator)

jobs.title: Business Resiliency Manager
jobs.description:
Bring your expertise to JPMorgan Chase. As part of a growing resiliency testing organization, you will play a key role in helping businesses strengthen preparedness, validate resiliency capabilities, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement through meaningful testing and simulation activities.

As an Incident Manager, Vice President within a Business Resiliency organization, you will provide senior leadership for major incidents and disruptions impacting customers, employees, and lines of business while setting direction for readiness, governance, communications, and execution quality. You will operate in a high-stakes, matrix environment, make risk-informed escalation decisions, advise senior leaders, and mobilize technology, operations, and corporate function teams to accelerate restoration, manage material risk, and reduce repeat events. You will also guide team members, sponsor strategic improvements, and strengthen the organization’s incident management operating model.

Job Responsibilities

• Lead and govern high-severity incident response, including Priority 1 / major issues, establishing the operating posture and response strategy and leading business bridge calls / situation rooms to align stakeholders on impacts, priorities, decisions, ownership, risks, and recovery actions.
• Translate fast-moving technical and operational inputs into concise, decision-oriented business and end-user impact narratives; provide executive-ready updates, recommendations, and risk perspectives to senior leaders.
• Exercise independent, risk-based judgment to determine when issues require monitoring, escalation, managed response, leadership awareness, or broader partner engagement; constructively challenge response plans and drive timely decisions.
• Oversee incident tooling, repositories, partner channels, and handoffs to ensure timely triage, routing, documentation, control adherence, and sustained action ownership across multiple teams.

jobs.title: Senior Lead Infrastructure Engineer - Enterprise Technology Data Protection & Recovery
jobs.description:
Push the limits of what’s possible with us as an experienced senior member of our product team.

As a Senior Lead Infrastructure Engineer at JPMorgan Chase within the Enterprise Technology Data Protection & Recovery product line, you will operate at the intersection of infrastructure engineering, product ownership, and risk. You will own the product vision, roadmap, and backlog for the Resiliency Evidence Service (RES), the platform of record for capturing, validating, and reporting resiliency evidence across the firm, while providing hands-on technical leadership to the platform, application, and infrastructure teams that produce and consume that evidence. You will translate control objectives, regulatory expectations, and recovery targets (RTO/RPO) into concrete engineering guidance, evidence contracts, and delivery plans, then partner with global development and infrastructure teams to make those outcomes real.

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

• Own the product vision, roadmap, and quarterly plan for the Resiliency Evidence Service; translate firmwide resiliency, risk, and audit objectives into a prioritized backlog with clear outcomes, success metrics, and release milestones.

• Act as the single-threaded product owner: groom and prioritize the backlog, run sprint planning and reviews, manage cross-team dependencies, and communicate status, risks, and trade-offs to engineering, product, risk, and executive stakeholders.

• Provide hands-on infrastructure engineering leadership: define reference architectures, evidence contracts (schemas, APIs, event formats), and integration patterns that partner teams use to emit resiliency evidence into RES.

• Guide development and infrastructure teams on controls and control objectives from a risk perspective; interpret firmwide standards, recovery objectives, and audit findings into concrete engineering requirements, acceptance criteria, and evidence artifacts.

• Partner with platform, application, and infrastructure teams to help them design, instrument, and produce the telemetry, attestations, restore proofs, and control evidence consumed by RES; run working sessions, review designs, and unblock adoption.

• Steward the end-to-end architecture of RES ingestion, storage, validation, and reporting surfaces; define domain boundaries, service contracts, and cross-service standards, and maintain architectural decision records.

• Drive resilient service design for RES itself: manage availability SLOs, latency budgets, and error budgets; lead DR tests, restore validation exercises, and chaos/resilience drills for the platform and its dependencies.

• Champion the secure SDLC across the ecosystem: threat modeling, SAST/DAST integration, dependency and SBOM management, secrets hygiene, encryption in transit and at rest, and robust authentication/authorization patterns for evidence pipelines.

• Advance observability and SRE practices: instrument metrics, logs, and traces across ingestion and reporting paths; design actionable alerts; author runbooks; lead incident response and blameless postmortems for both RES and the evidence supply chain.

• Support CI/CD and test quality across the product line: maintain an end-to-end understanding of how RES services, evidence pipelines, and partner integrations fit together and are tested (unit, integration, contract, performance); set expectations for coverage, quality gates, and progressive delivery (canary/blue-green) with rollback plans; review results, triage failures, and guide engineers to the likely root cause when tests or pipelines break.

• Represent RES with Risk, Controls, Audit, and Compliance partners; produce data-backed status updates, escalation requests, and evidence packages that demonstrate control effectiveness and recovery posture.

• Support critical environments (Development, QA, Simulation, Production) and lead management of on-call obligations for owned services, ensuring operational stability and timely resolution of incidents.

• Contribute to the engineering community as an advocate of firmwide frameworks, tools, and best practices; add to team culture by fostering diversity, inclusion, and respect.

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

• 5+ years’ experience in infrastructure, platform, or software engineering, with a proven track record leading cross-team delivery of production platforms in a large, regulated environment.

• Demonstrated product ownership experience: authoring and maintaining a roadmap, running a prioritized backlog, leading sprint ceremonies, and managing stakeholder expectations across engineering, product, and risk audiences.

• Deep knowledge of resiliency engineering and disaster recovery objectives with hands-on practice running DR tests, restore validation, and chaos/resilience exercises.

• Strong understanding of technology risk and control frameworks: ability to interpret control objectives, regulatory expectations, and audit findings and translate them into concrete engineering requirements, evidence artifacts, and acceptance criteria.

• Hands-on infrastructure engineering experience: Linux, containers and orchestration (Kubernetes), infrastructure as code (Terraform or equivalent), multi-AZ/region architectures, and cost-efficient scalability; hands-on experience with AWS and awareness of other cloud providers.

• Working proficiency in at least one general-purpose programming language (e.g., Python, Java) sufficient to understand and design APIs, define integration tooling, prototype evidence pipelines, and review partner-team code.

• Data and integration fluency: API design (REST/gRPC), event-driven patterns, schema evolution and compatibility, and practical experience with streaming or messaging platforms (Kafka or equivalent).

• Observability discipline: instrumentation of metrics/logs/traces, alerting design, runbooks, incident management, and blameless postmortems.

• Secure SDLC expertise: threat modeling, SAST/DAST integration, dependency risk/SBOM management, secrets handling, encryption standards, and robust authentication/authorization.

• DevOps/SDLC: familiarity with build tools, CI/CD systems, and version control (Git) with automated pipeline governance.

• Excellent written and verbal communication; able to move fluidly between deep technical review with engineers and outcome-oriented conversations with senior stakeholders.

• Ability to independently tackle complex design, delivery, and prioritization problems with minimal oversight.

Preferred qualifications

, capabilities, and skills

jobs.title: Manager, Resilience Risk
jobs.location: Mountain View, CA, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA
jobs.description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

The Waymo Safety team works to promote and help to continuously improve the safety of Waymo’s fully autonomous driving technology. Our experts develop safety goals and strategies, and conduct safety engineering analyses to ensure safety is being considered throughout the design and development of our vehicles. The team develops and promotes safety strategies and policies for autonomous vehicles for its work with regulatory authorities, lawmakers, law enforcement and public and non-profit organizations. Our Safety Team also helps advise on compliance with applicable environmental, health, and safety regulations.

In this hybrid role you will report into our Head of Enterprise Resilience.

You will:

• Lead and execute resilience risk assessments across critical business services, infrastructure, and operations; evaluate control effectiveness within a structured framework aligning with the broader Waymo Risk Management (WRM) strategy and Safety Management System (SMS).

• Develop, maintain, and own the Enterprise Resilience Risk Register with clear risk ownership; provide independent oversight of resilience risks and investigate deviations across Operations, Technology, and Safety to ensure robust compliance.

• Partner with cross-functional teams to proactively identify, monitor, and mitigate risks related to service disruptions (e.g., extreme weather, infrastructure failures, regulatory changes); provide informed, data-driven resilience opinions on major initiatives and market expansions.

• Lead the development of enterprise-wide resilience metrics, KPIs, and reporting dashboards to monitor SMS/policy performance; analyze trends and present findings to the organization and committees at all levels, surfacing key insights as a critical input for strategic prioritization and decision-making.

• Set the strategy, objectives, and escalation paths for your functional area, reporting regularly to the Executive Leadership Team (ELT), safety committees, and the risk board to ensure alignment with Waymo's approved risk appetite and manage the formal process around resilience risk acceptance.

• Monitor and rigorously evaluate the impact of newly proposed industry standards and regulatory requirements on Waymo's compliance programs, establishing strategic alliances to address cross-functional remediation plans.

You have:

• 8+ years of experience in a risk-related field, preferably with a focus on complex operations that include both software and real-world risk identification and control.

• Track record of strong cross-functional partnership with diverse stakeholders, especially to identify and map key dependencies, risks, and mitigations in complex operations.

• Extreme curiosity to understand the status quo, always asks “why?”, and considers alternatives.

• Exceptional attention to detail with the ability to synthesize complex information into clear and concise documentation and presentations.

• Proven track record of communicating complex risk profiles and strategies to diverse groups of stakeholders, including executive-level audiences and steering committees as well as frontline operational teams.

• Familiarity with foundational business continuity concepts, specifically the relationship between Business Impact Analysis (BIA) and risk assessments, to ensure impact analysis effectively informs a comprehensive enterprise resilience risk snapshot.

We prefer:

• Background building resilience-related risk programs in an evolving regulatory landscape at a fast-paced, quickly scaling company.

• Deep understanding of excellence as it relates to regulatory requirements related to risk management and ensuring requirements are met in a way that is conducive to improving the company’s understanding of compound risks, allowing for effective prioritization of mitigations and control.

• Experience evolving subjective, qualitative risk matrices into structured, data-driven frameworks utilizing capability maturity (e.g., CMMI) and quantitative risk (e.g., FAIR or Value-at-Risk) models.

• Experience in highly regulated industries such as Automotive, Maritime, Aviation, or similar sectors, providing familiarity with safety-critical systems, compliance frameworks, and complex operational procedures.

• Demonstrated experience leading rigorous auditing and conformance exercises toward both voluntary and regulatory compliance (e.g., ISO 31000, ISO 22301, or safety-critical frameworks)

• Demonstrated intellectual curiosity and a forward-thinking approach to leveraging data and AI tools (such as Gemini and Google Workspace) to optimize processes and solve complex problems, even if without direct technical development experience.

Travel:

• As required, < 20%

The expected base salary range for this full-time position across US locations is listed below. Actual starting pay will be based on job-related factors, including exact work location, experience, relevant training and education, and skill level. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for the role location or, if the role can be performed remote, the specific salary range for your preferred location, during the hiring process.

Waymo employees are also eligible to participate in Waymo’s discretionary annual bonus program, equity incentive plan, and generous Company benefits program, subject to eligibility requirements.

Salary Range

$200,000 — $247,000 USD
